column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.1.0 (commit 1368652, tag object 441f383) is the newest published build and the only one. The
# repo publishes v* releases only, no dev pre-release, and no predecessor repo shipped this mod. It
# pinned core b8d47eb. src/config.cpp, src/config.h, src/config_sanitize.h and src/logging.h are byte
# for byte the same at v0.1.0 and at a5ca797, the commit the reader was frozen at, and every core
# source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at b8d47eb and at the current pin, so
# v0.1.0's release ZIP and launcher-manifest.json shipped no HeadTracking.ini and seeded none: its
# first start wrote it from kDefaultIniText in src/config.cpp. That text, extracted once, is the
# first-run input. The repo's HeadTracking.ini has one committed version, 9eefc41, unchanged
# through v0.1.0, and checked out with CRLF (.gitattributes *.ini eol=crlf) it holds the same bytes,
# so it is the same input.

column2: kDefaultIniText at v0.1.0, what its first start wrote, and 9eefc41:HeadTracking.ini: data/firstrun-v0.1.0.ini
